observations.text_or_visual_description: The football team has four years. So do we. Not to spend convincing the world that Congo matters. But to spend becoming so deeply rooted in who we are that the world keeps discovering Congo through us. Not through one football team. (Big up the Leopards for real) Through millions of Congolese people. That's the strategy.
Three DRC Leopards players in blue kit celebrating together with raised fists, AFCON Cote d'Ivoire 23 banners visible, green stadium background
